core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu's basic attacks apply Curse to enemies.
Cursed enemies take bonus true damage when they receive magic damage.
core_coverage.reason: Identifies the triggering damage and the bonus damage type without restricting the magic damage source.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu throws a bandage that deals magic damage and stuns the first enemy hit, pulling him to them.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the thrown projectile, first-enemy collision, magic damage and stun.
Clearly identifies Amumu as moving to the enemy hit.

core_coverage.answer_quote: He stores up to two charges that replenish over time.
core_coverage.reason: States the supported charge limit and periodic replenishment.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu toggles an aura that continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies, including damage based on their maximum health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the toggle, nearby ongoing magic damage and maximum-health component.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Its damage refreshes existing Curse marks.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly limits refreshes to existing marks.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Tantrum passively reduces incoming physical damage.
core_coverage.reason: Explains passive physical damage reduction without implying complete negation.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Activating it deals magic damage to surrounding enemies.
core_coverage.reason: States the activation, damage type and surrounding area.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Basic attacks that hit Amumu reduce its remaining cooldown.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the supported basic-attack trigger and remaining-cooldown reduction. Detailed blocked-attack and on-hit interactions are optional here and retained in metadata.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Amumu deals magic damage to surrounding enemies and stuns them.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both magic damage and stun in the area surrounding Amumu.

core_coverage.answer_quote: He also applies Curse to affected enemies.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly explains Curse application without claiming it amplifies R's own initial hit.

conflicts.resolution: The draft appropriately uses Wiki's more specific basic-attack trigger. Riot's broader wording does not establish that spells or every damage tick reduce the cooldown. Detailed hit interactions remain in metadata.
conflicts.topic: E cooldown reduction: Riot says each time Amumu is hit; Wiki specifies basic attacks and on-hit interactions.

factual_risks: Assessment uses only supplied frozen excerpts; current-client behavior and visuals are unverified.
The L1 tank-stat build focus is inferred teaching guidance, not an evidence-established optimal build.
Counterplay follows the supplied mechanics as conditional advice, without guaranteed outcomes or invented timings.
Supported advanced exceptions are retained in draft metadata; their omission from concise answers does not make these general descriptions misleading.
